description.default: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes. Also covers discussions, notifications, deployments and check runs, organizations and teams, gists and packages.
description.en: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes. Also covers discussions, notifications, deployments and check runs, organizations and teams, gists and packages.
description.zh-CN: GitHub 工具，自带结果卡片：查询仓库、议题、提交、PR、文件、代码与 Actions，执行 GraphQL，并支持评论、审查、Revert PR、Release 资产和远端写操作。另可查询讨论、通知、部署与检查运行、组织与团队、Gist 和软件包。
description.zh-TW: GitHub 工具，自帶結果卡片：查詢儲存庫、議題、提交、PR、檔案、程式碼與 Actions，執行 GraphQL，並支援評論、審查、Revert PR、Release 資產和遠端寫操作。另可查詢討論、通知、部署與檢查執行、組織與團隊、Gist 和套件。

privacy.note: 按调用参数访问 api.github.com；Release 资产原始字节上传至 uploads.github.com；GraphQL 查询或 mutation 会发送到 GitHub，mutation 可产生远端写副作用。只读 REST 工具可按 GitHub 规则匿名使用，代码搜索、GraphQL 与写工具需要 GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN 或本机 gh CLI 令牌。Actions 构件工具只读取官方 302 的 HTTPS Location，不跟随重定向；一分钟有效的下载 URL 会作为当前工具结果交付并由用户点击打开。工具卡只读取宿主提供的当前工具调用快照。不读取任意本地资产路径、不写入本地输出路径，也不把令牌写入插件目录或额外日志。
